sql_referencia: SELECT count(DISTINCT m.merchant_sk) AS comercios_activos FROM dim_merchant m WHERE m.is_current AND m.is_active AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v_attempt_dedup p WHERE p.merchant_sk = m.merchant_sk AND p.auth_status = 'approved' AND NOT p.is_test AND p.event_date > (SELECT max(event_date) FROM fact_payment_attempt) - INTERVAL 30 DAY)
